experimental_method: Gas volumetric absorption of CO2 at about 1 atm into aqueous electrolyte solutions in a 30 cm3 absorption chamber in an air bath held to 0.05 C (apparatus of Tokunaga); Ostwald coefficient evaluated with vapour pressure of the solution and a small volume-dilatation correction.
uncertainties_stated: Air bath controlled within 0.05 C; average deviations of replicate pure-water determinations 0.06 to 0.24 % (Table I); CO2 99.96 % pure; solution concentration by chemical analysis or evaporation to dryness. No per-point uncertainty.
quality_remarks: Pure-water results agree with Markham and Kobe within about 1.3 % at 15 C (1.0634 vs 1.075). Text: NH4Cl, (NH4)2SO4 and CaCl2 do not obey the Setschenow equation. Table II lists replicate or near-replicate Cs values (e.g. KCl 35 C 3.619/3.660) as printed; none dropped. Whether 760 mmHg is total or CO2 partial pressure is not stated.
